additional_info.body:
Hello ﻿Orel,﻿
Thank you for reaching out to eMobility Support. My name is
Shrey
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
MP / P4 170000451
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
XnRMdn
Problem Description
: Outlets out of order
Troubleshooting
:
We have analyzed the logs and the picture shared by you, and we conclude that there were two instances when the DC outlet 1 and DC outlet 2 went out of order. This was due to an error polling Coap issue, which is a known issue that has already been addressed to the product care team, and they are working on it. This issue will be fixed in the upcoming firmware release.
The SECC might lose communication with the Linux controller and show the following error: "Error polling Coap message." Our charger will reconnect to the SECC within 5 seconds. This issue is self-resolvable and doesn't impact the charger significantly.
Additionally, I checked the AWS logs for the past couple of days and found that there are not many instances where outlets go out of order due to this issue. It is not affecting any charging sessions.
Please let me know if you have any further queries. If not, shall we proceed with closing this ticket?
For future reference, your ticket number is
0371539
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Shrey Sharma
